item.title: metacheck: 28 commits today
item.description:
scienceverse/metacheck

Summary unavailable.

28 commit(s) today:

  • d490af4 [dev] Merge pull request #671 from scienceverse/link_improvement — Daniel Lakens
  • 49f2a80 [dev] Files inside a zip whose address has a space are downloaded too (#667): the address is encoded in .mc_request(), which nearly every request goes through, including the byte-range requests that fetch a zip's members, and in code_read() and .batch_query(). In metapsych.mp20234008 all 432 members of a GitHub zip still failed in 0.4.4.13. An address already encoded is left as it is. Version 0.4.4.14 — Lakens
  • 33b9965 [dev] repo_check keeps an R package in a subfolder when the repository holds no other data or code (#505): a package is left out as someone else's software only when real data or code is in the repository outside every package, wherever the package sits. Before, a package in a subfolder was always left out, so 10.1111/2041-210X.14387, whose own package sits in "good 2/", had no files. A README (also README.Rmd, which classifies as code) no longer counts as code in this decision. — Lakens
  • 4725175 [dev] Merge pull request #669 from scienceverse/fix_667_url_spaces — Daniel Lakens
  • 4f81dbc [dev] Merge dev into fix_667_url_spaces: keep the NEWS entries of both. Version 0.4.4.13 — Lakens
  • 0845b72 [dev] Merge pull request #665 from scienceverse/economics_journals — Daniel Lakens
  • ed7dabb [dev] Merge pull request #670 from scienceverse/ci_fewer_platforms — Daniel Lakens
  • 49d2659 [dev] Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/dev' into economics_journals — Lakens
  • e4b92ba [ci_fewer_platforms] R CMD check: a pull request into dev is checked on Linux and Windows with the released R only; all seven systems for a pull request into main, a weekly run, a run by hand and a push to cran_fixes or linux_docker_fixes. A push to dev is no longer checked again after its pull request was. — Lakens
  • 7c895ee [dev] Files in GitHub and GitLab repositories whose path holds a space are downloaded again, and files that could not be downloaded are shown in the report and counted (#667). Version 0.4.4.12 — Lakens
  • c07fbc5 [ci_fewer_platforms] Merge pull request #666 from scienceverse/osf_example_outage — Daniel Lakens
  • c7a95fc [ci_fewer_platforms] osf_api_check(): its example warns instead of stopping when the OSF is down, so an OSF outage no longer fails R CMD check (an Error 500 failed the checks of #664 and #665 on every platform on 2026-11-18). Version 0.4.4.11 — Lakens
  • f69c0e5 [dev] Merge branch 'more_services_660' into economics_journals — Lakens
  • 18c6538 [dev] cran_links() and handle_links(): name the repo_check module in words, not as a help link it does not have, and shorten an example line (R CMD check warned on all platforms) — Lakens
  • 7e17a34 [dev] repo_check recognises replication packages at ICPSR and openICPSR, including the AEA Data and Code Repository (economics journals). Version 0.4.4.10 — Lakens
  • 3cf0dc8 [dev] repo_check supports more data and code sharing services (#660): file-sharing services get a warning; sequence and expression archives, CRAN packages and Handle links are found and classified, and the paper's own archive deposits and packages are listed. Version 0.4.4.9 — Lakens
  • 75ee657 [main] Merge pull request #663 from scienceverse/dev — Daniel Lakens
  • 9733d90 [ci_fewer_platforms] Merge pull request #661 from scienceverse/fix_648_batches — Daniel Lakens
  • 1204b52 [ci_fewer_platforms] data_check_pii_name(): write the month names' accented letters as \u escapes, as R code must be ASCII (R CMD check warned on all platforms) — Lakens
  • 74d8279 [ci_fewer_platforms] repo_check checks a deposit the paper cites only in its reference list when it is the authors' own for this paper (#644): ownership own_this adds it to the repositories checked, so its files reach table and data_check, code_check and reproducibility_check; the report names it with the advice to link it in the data availability statement; summary_table gains ref_own. A DOI written in a reference and given as its link is one deposit (.own_key()): before, the lookup matched its record to one form only, and one record was both the paper's own deposit and a publication. Two Proc. R. Soc. B papers went from no repository to 2 (1,362 files) and 1 (45 files). — Lakens
